description.en: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy.
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害。

summary.en: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量虚数属性伤害。

description.en: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals 2 instances of DMG, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to a random enemy. On hit, there is a #2[i]% base chance to reduce the enemy's SPD by #3[i]% for #4[i] turn(s).
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害，并额外造成2次伤害。每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害。攻击命中时有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标速度降低#3[i]%，持续#4[i]回合。

summary.en: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy. This attack can Bounce 3 times, with a chance of Slowing the hit enemies.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量虚数属性伤害，共弹射3次，有概率对目标施加减速状态。

description.en:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to all enemies, with a #3[i]% base chance for enemies hit by this ability to be Imprisoned for 1 turn.
Imprisoned enemies have their actions delayed by #2[f1]% and SPD reduced by #4[i]%.
description.zh-CN:
对敌方全体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害，有#3[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入禁锢状态，持续1回合。
禁锢状态下，敌方目标行动延后#2[f1]%，速度降低#4[i]%。

summary.en: Deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies, with a high chance of Imprisoning them.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方全体造成虚数属性伤害，大概率施加禁锢效果。

description.en: When hitting an enemy that is already Slowed, Welt deals Imaginary Additional DMG equal to #1[i]% of his ATK to the enemy.
description.zh-CN: 击中处于减速状态的敌方目标时，额外造成1次等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性附加伤害。

summary.en: When hitting a Slowed enemy, additionally deals minor Imaginary Additional DMG.
summary.zh-CN: 击中处于减速状态的敌方目标时，额外造成少量虚数属性附加伤害。

description.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
description.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

summary.en: Attacks an enemy, and after entering combat, reduces their Toughness of the corresponding Type.
summary.zh-CN: 攻击敌人，进入战斗后削弱敌方目标对应属性韧性。

description.en:
After using Welt's Technique, create a Special Dimension that lasts for #4[i] second(s). Enemies in this Special Dimension have their movement speed reduced by #5[i]%. After entering battle with enemies in the Special Dimension, there is a #1[i]% base chance to Imprison the enemies for 1 turn.
Imprisoned enemies have their actions delayed by #2[i]% and SPD reduced by #3[i]%. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.
description.zh-CN:
使用秘技后，制造1片持续#4[i]秒的特殊领域。处于特殊领域内的敌人移动速度降低#5[i]%。与处于特殊领域内的敌人进入战斗后，有#1[i]%的基础概率使敌方目标陷入禁锢状态，持续1回合。
禁锢状态下，敌方目标行动延后#2[i]%，速度降低#3[i]%。我方制造的领域效果最多存在1个。

summary.en: Creates a Special Dimension. Enemies in this dimension have their movement speed reduced. After entering combat with enemies in the dimension, there is a high chance for the enemies to become Imprisoned.
summary.zh-CN: 制造特殊领域。领域内敌人移动速度降低。与领域内敌人进入战斗后，大概率使敌方目标陷入禁锢状态。

description.en: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy.
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害。

summary.en: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量虚数属性伤害。

description.en: Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to one designated enemy and additionally deals DMG 4 times, with each time dealing Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to one random enemy. On hit, there is a #2[i]% base chance to reduce the enemy's SPD by #3[i]% for #4[i] turn(s).
description.zh-CN: 对指定敌方单体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害，并额外造成4次伤害。每次伤害对敌方随机单体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害。攻击命中时有#2[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标速度降低#3[i]%，持续#4[i]回合。

summary.en: Deals minor Imaginary DMG to one enemy. This attack can Bounce 5 times, with a chance of Slowing the hit enemies.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方单体造成少量虚数属性伤害，共弹射5次，有概率对目标施加减速状态。

description.en:
Deals Imaginary DMG equal to #1[i]% of Welt's ATK to all enemies. Has a #3[i]% base chance to Imprison hit enemy targets for 1 turn.
While Imprisoned, enemy targets have their actions delayed by #2[f1]% and their SPD reduced by #4[i]%. After using his Ultimate, inflicts the "Weightless" state on all enemies. When targets in "Weightless" state get attacked, their actions are delayed by #5[f1]%. This effect can trigger up to #6[i] time(s) per target per turn. "Weightless" lasts for #7[i] turn(s).
description.zh-CN:
对敌方全体造成等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性伤害，有#3[i]%的基础概率使受到攻击的敌方目标陷入禁锢状态，持续1回合。
禁锢状态下，敌方目标行动延后#2[f1]%，速度降低#4[i]%。施放终结技后使敌方全体陷入【失重】状态，【失重】状态下的敌方目标受到攻击时行动延后#5[f1]%，该效果每个目标每回合内最多触发#6[i]次，【失重】状态持续#7[i]回合。

summary.en: Deals Imaginary DMG to all enemies with a high chance to inflict Imprisonment. Inflicts all enemies with "Weightless": when attacked, their actions are delayed.
summary.zh-CN: 对敌方全体造成虚数属性伤害，大概率施加禁锢效果。使敌方全体陷入【失重】状态：受到攻击时行动延后。

description.en: Enemy targets in the "Weightless" state have their DEF reduced by #2[i]% and their SPD reduced by #3[i]%. When Welt attacks an enemy that is already Slowed, he additionally deals Imaginary Additional DMG equal to #1[i]% of his ATK to the enemy.
description.zh-CN: 处于【失重】状态下的敌方目标防御力降低#2[i]%，速度降低#3[i]%。瓦尔特击中处于减速状态的敌方目标时，额外造成1次等同于瓦尔特#1[i]%攻击力的虚数属性附加伤害。

summary.en: Enemy targets in the "Weightless" state have reduced DEF and SPD. When hitting a Slowed enemy target, additionally deals minor Imaginary Additional DMG.
summary.zh-CN: 处于【失重】状态下的敌方目标防御力及速度降低。击中处于减速状态的敌方目标时，额外造成少量虚数属性附加伤害。

Imprisoned enemies have their actions delayed by #2[i]% and SPD reduced by #3[i]%. Only 1 Dimension Effect created by allies can exist at the same time.

禁锢状态下，敌方目标行动延后#2[i]%，速度降低#3[i]%。我方制造的领域效果最多存在1个。

summary.zh-CN: 制造特殊领域。领域内敌人移动速度降低。与领域内敌人进入战斗后，大概率使敌方目标陷入禁锢状态。

description.en: After using Ultimate, Welt gets enhanced. Then, the next 2 time(s) he uses Basic ATK or Skill, deals 1 extra instance of Additional DMG to the enemy target. The Additional DMG dealt when using Basic ATK is equal to 50% of Basic ATK DMG multiplier. The Additional DMG dealt when using Skill is equal to 80% of Skill DMG multiplier.
description.zh-CN: 施放终结技后，瓦尔特获得强化，在随后2次施放普攻或战技时额外对敌方目标造成1次附加伤害。施放普攻造成的附加伤害等同于普攻伤害倍率的50%，施放战技造成的附加伤害等同于战技伤害倍率的80%。

description.en: When his Talent is triggered, Welt regenerates 3 Energy.
description.zh-CN: 触发天赋时，瓦尔特恢复3点能量。

description.en:
Skill Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Basic ATK Lv. +1, up to a maximum of Lv. 10.
description.zh-CN: 战技等级+2，最多不超过15级；普攻等级+1，最多不超过10级。

description.en: When using Skill, increases the base chance of reducing the attacked enemy target's SPD by 35%.
description.zh-CN: 施放战技时，使受到攻击的敌方目标速度降低的基础概率提高35%。

description.en:
Ultimate Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
Talent Lv. +2, up to a maximum of Lv. 15.
description.zh-CN: 终结技等级+2，最多不超过15级；天赋等级+2，最多不超过15级。

description.en: When using Skill, deals DMG for 1 extra time to one random enemy.
description.zh-CN: 施放战技时，对随机敌方单体额外造成1次伤害。

description.en: When using Ultimate, there is a #1[i]% base chance to increase the DMG taken by the targets by #2[i]% for #3[i] turn(s).
description.zh-CN: 施放终结技时，有#1[i]%基础概率使目标受到的伤害提高#2[i]%，持续#3[i]回合。

description.en: Using Ultimate additionally regenerates #1[i] Energy.
description.zh-CN: 施放终结技时，额外恢复#1[i]点能量。

description.en: Deals #1[i]% more DMG to enemies inflicted with Weakness Break.
description.zh-CN: 对被弱点击破的敌方目标造成的伤害提高#1[i]%。

description.en: When ally targets attack targets under the "Weightless" state, their DMG dealt increases by #1[i]%. This effect stacks up to #2[i] times and lasts for #3[i] turn(s). At the start of the battle, Welt regenerates #4[i] Energy.
description.zh-CN: 我方目标攻击【失重】状态下的目标时，造成的伤害提高#1[i]%，该效果最多叠加#2[i]层，持续#3[i]回合。战斗开始时瓦尔特恢复#4[i]点能量。

description.en: When Welt uses Basic ATK or Skill, additionally deals 1 extra instance of Additional DMG to the enemy target. The Additional DMG dealt when using Basic ATK is equal to #1[i]% of Basic ATK DMG multiplier. The Additional DMG dealt when using Skill is equal to #2[i]% of Skill DMG multiplier.
description.zh-CN: 施放普攻或战技时额外对敌方目标造成1次附加伤害。施放普攻造成的附加伤害等同于普攻伤害倍率的#1[i]%，施放战技造成的附加伤害等同于战技伤害倍率的#2[i]%。

description.en: When Welt's Effect Hit Rate is greater than #1[i]%, for every #2[i]% that exceeds this value, increases ATK by #3[i]%, up to a maximum increase of #4[i]%. When using Ultimate, additionally restores #5[i] Energy.
description.zh-CN: 瓦尔特的效果命中大于#1[i]%时，每超过#2[i]%，则攻击力提高#3[i]%，最多提高#4[i]%。施放终结技时，额外恢复#5[i]点能量。
